name: JetBrains Student Pack
summary: Free JetBrains IDEs, such as IntelliJ IDEA and PyCharm, for students.
need: A university email address, an ISIC card, or a GitHub Student Developer Pack.
how: Apply on JetBrains' student page with your uni email or ISIC card, or choose Authorize with GitHub if you have the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
catches: Official school documents are no longer accepted as proof, since July 2024.

source.label: JetBrains Sales Support: applying for an educational licence

open_questions: Eligibility rules (full-time, course length) and licence length could not be read: jetbrains.com education pages returned no content or blocked automated reading.
Grok's 'full-time student in accredited program of at least 1 year' and 'for the duration of studies' are unconfirmed.
